item.title: UK landlords unprepared for Renters’ Rights Act reforms: Inventory Base survey
item.description: The UK’s rental housing market is set to undergo significant changes as the first phase of the Renters Rights Act (RRA) kicks in on May 1. The legislation, approved last October, will introduce reforms aimed at enhancing tenant protections and regulating landlords. Key changes under the first phase of reforms include the abolishment of “no-fault” Section 21 evictions. item.description: The Year of the Fire Horse is 2026 (specifically 17 Feb 2026 – 5 Feb 2027, according to the Lunar Calendar), a rare 60-year cycle. The last Year of the Fire Horse fell in 1966, just a year after Singapore gained independence and embarked on its development path. item.title: A five-room flat along Dawson Road sold for $1.7 million - highest price ever in Singapore based on HDB data
item.description: A five-room flat at 92 Dawson Road was just sold for $1.7 million ($1,295 psf). Based on data from HDB, this is not only the highest price ever paid for an HDB flat in Queenstown but also a record high for HDB flats in Singapore. The subject flat measures 1,313 sq ft and has a remaining lease of approximately 89 years. item.title: A five-room flat in Punggol was just sold for $1.47 million, setting a new record-high for such flats in the town
item.description: A five-room HDB flat at 306D Punggol Drive was recently sold for $1.47 million ($929 psf), marking a new record high for five-room flats in Punggol. Located on the 16th to 18th storeys, the subject flat measures a spacious 1,582 sq ft and has a remaining lease of around 85 years.
